record.paper_title: Some open problems on best approximation in normed linear spaces
record.context_brief: Weak versus strong continuity of the metric projection onto a Chebyshev set
record.original_question: If G is a Chebyshev set and the metric projection pi_G that sends each point x to its unique best approximation in G is weakly continuous, must pi_G also be strongly continuous?

evidence.quote: it is not known whether the weak continuity of pi_G , where G is a Cebysev set, implies its strong continuity.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a real normed linear space. A nonempty subset $G \subseteq X$ is called a Chebyshev set if for every $x \in X$ there exists a unique element $\pi_G(x) \in G$ with $\|x - \pi_G(x)\| = \inf_{g \in G} \|x - g\|$. The map $\pi_G : X \to G$ is called the metric projection onto $G$.

The map $\pi_G$ is said to be weakly continuous at $x \in X$ if, whenever $(x_n)_{n \ge 1} \subset X$ converges in norm to $x$, the sequence $(\pi_G(x_n))$ converges weakly to $\pi_G(x)$. It is said to be strongly continuous at $x$ if $(\pi_G(x_n))$ converges in norm to $\pi_G(x)$ whenever $x_n \to x$ in norm.

Question: If $G$ is a Chebyshev set in a normed linear space $X$ such that the metric projection $\pi_G$ is weakly continuous (at every point of $X$), must $\pi_G$ also be strongly continuous?
artifact.status_search_result: A web search returned general results on continuity of metric projections (e.g., norm continuity under Kadec–Klee/reflexivity or approximate compactness assumptions), but no source directly resolving the general question of whether weak continuity of the metric projection onto an arbitrary Chebyshev set forces norm continuity. The status appears unresolved in the literature found.

status_evidence.title: Chebyshev sets (Cambridge)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey on Chebyshev sets discussing continuity properties of metric projections without resolving the weak-vs-strong continuity implication in general.
status_evidence.claim: Standard survey discusses continuity but does not record a general resolution of the weak-implies-strong continuity question.

status_evidence.title: Chebyshev set - Encyclopedia of Mathematics
status_evidence.snippet: Encyclopedia entry summarizing known continuity results for metric projections onto Chebyshev sets.
status_evidence.claim: No mention of a general theorem deriving norm continuity from weak continuity of the metric projection onto a Chebyshev set.
